name: arcade-mcp-evaluation-run-plans-and-provenance
instr:
`arcade_evals` cannot currently produce a deterministic, offline-inspectable evaluation run plan that preserves stable source, suite, case, provider, and model identity through execution. Build that plan so every reported outcome remains traceable to its planned work. Suite and case selection must constrain regular, capture, and comparative evaluation without weakening existing discovery or result behavior.

Plan construction must be deterministic, resolve source identity, distinguish every decorated suite, and fingerprint only selected definitions and inputs. Selectors include exactly matching work. Diagnose ambiguous, unmatched, or stale selections before provider work begins. Reject mismatched plans and selected-definition drift before provider execution, while unrelated definition changes leave an unchanged selected plan valid.

Preserve discovery recursion, direct-file handling, exclusions, sibling imports, path cleanup, established observations, stable suite identities, and successful neighboring imports when another source fails. Same-named suites from different files remain distinct during preflight, execution, and unplanned-outcome reporting.

Every execution mode runs only planned cases and preserves provenance in outcomes, completion observations, and failure messages. Comparative tracks share one originating planned case identity while retaining distinct track outcomes. Capture and comparative execution share selected-case provenance while preserving mode-specific
